facts.material: tin, silver and copper metal powder (SAC-type lead-free solder alloy; tin assumed predominant, silver and copper minor)
facts.function: solder powder, to be made into solder paste

gri_path: GRI 1: Section XV note 8(b) defines powders; note 7 governs mixed base-metal articles by predominant metal (tin); heading 8001 excludes tin powders (EN), so heading 8007 other articles of tin

rejected_alternatives.reason: silver is a minor component; tin predominates
coated rods and wire, not powder

missing_facts: exact percentages (tin assumed to predominate, as in SAC alloys); particle size
classification.rationale: Tin-lead solder powder in N357709 was classified in 8007.00.3200 as a tin powder under Section XV notes 7 and 8(b); the same logic applies to a tin-silver-copper powder where tin predominates by weight.
